top_signals.title: Libya’s Oil Output Drops as Pipeline Shutdown Hits Biggest Field
top_signals.summary: Libya’s oil production dropped after a group disrupted a pipeline that carries crude from the country’s biggest field, the latest in a number of incidents in recent months that have curbed supply from the OPEC member.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Timely Fuel Payments Crucial to Boost Pertamina’s Cash, S&P Says
top_signals.summary: Timely compensation from the Indonesian government is critical to boost PT Pertamina’s cash flow with the state oil company’s receivables reaching $9.6 billion for the nine months through September, according to S&P Global Ratings.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Ant Group bets on Simplexity to thrive in China’s humanoid race
top_signals.summary: China's humanoid robotics have taken an early lead over U.S. rivals, accounting for 97% of machines shipped in the first three quarters of 2026.
